state: A classroom projector is offline. Its power indicator is on. The upstream switch reports 70 percent packet loss and other devices on that switch are unreachable.

specialist.instructions: Which specialist should investigate first? Select human_review if the evidence is insufficient or conflicting.

criteria.network: Connectivity, packet loss, switches, and shared network dependencies
criteria.system: Device operating system or application faults
criteria.power: Power supply faults and equipment without power
criteria.human_review: Insufficient evidence, conflicting observations, or none of the other specialists
